title: 2025 book drive: Rs 207,429
summary: Raised Rs 207,429 from 22 contributions for books for rural schools. Up from Rs 134,954 the drive before.
what_would_have_happened: Children in rural schools start the year without enough notebooks and books.
the_call: Ask friends and colleagues every year, and send the money straight to a charity that buys and delivers the books.
what_i_did: Organized the drive, collected 22 contributions and passed them to a charitable trust in Mysuru that buys and distributes the books.
what_changed: Rs 207,429 for books. Up from Rs 134,954 the drive before.
